_comment_top: Single source of truth for all debounce, polling, cache TTL, and toast timings.
_comment_units: Frontend values are in milliseconds. Backend cacheTTL values are in SECONDS.
_comment_edit: Deployer can tune the system by editing this file alone. Backend reads via config('timing.*'); frontend fetches via GET /api/config/timing. Auth tokens (10-min reset/bind expiry) are NOT here — kept hardcoded in AuthService for security.

input._comment: Debounce after user types in a textarea.

background._comment_hud: Aligned with backend status:online cache TTL — polling more often gives the same cached answer.

toast._comment: How long each toast type stays on screen.
toast._comment_error: Errors stay longer so the user has time to read what failed.

timeout._comment: Hard limits — give up after this long.
timeout._comment_blobUrlRevoke: Used by Save-As (60s is enough for the browser to start the download). openFile() uses the server URL when available — no blob URL involved.
timeout._comment_blobUrlRevokeOffline: openFile() fallback when file is local-only (no server copy). 10 minutes — long enough to read a PDF/image.

backend._comment: Values are SECONDS (Laravel Cache::remember TTL convention).

cacheTTL._comment_fileMetadata: FileService::getByHash cache — file metadata is immutable so longer TTL is safe.
